an1.1:0.1: The Book of the Gradual Sayings II
an1.1:0.2: 1. The Section on Form and So On
an1.1:1.2: At one time the Fortunate One was dwelling near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Wood, in Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
an1.1:1.3: There the Fortunate One addressed the monks, saying:
an1.1:1.5: “Yes, reverend Sir,” the monks answered the Blessed One.
an1.1:2.1: “Bhikkhus, I do not see even one form that so dominates the mind of a man as does the form of a woman.
an1.1:2.2: “Bhikkhus, the form of a woman persists in occupying a man’s mind.
an1.2:1.1: “Bhikkhus, I do not see even one sound that, when heard, obsesses the minds of men as much as the sound of a woman’s voice.
an1.2:1.2: The sound of a woman, monks, can occupy the mind of a man.”
an1.3:1.1: “Bhikkhus, I do not see even a single scent that so dominates the mind of a man as does the scent of a woman.
an1.3:1.2: “The scent of a woman, monastics, dominates a man’s mind.”
an1.4:1.1: “Bhikkhus, I do not see even one taste that, when tasted, possesses such ravishing power over a man’s mind as the taste of a woman.
an1.4:1.2: “The mind of a man is obsessed by passion for a woman.
an1.5:1.1: “Bhikkhus, I do not see even one kind of contact that so occupies a man’s mind as the contact with a woman.
an1.5:1.2: Physical contact with a woman, monks, seizes the mind of a man and remains there.
an1.6:1.1: “Bhikkhus, I do not see even one form that seizes and holds the mind of a woman as much as does the form of a man.
an1.6:1.2: The form of a man, bhikkhus, obsesses the mind of a woman.
an1.7:1.1: “Bhikkhus, I do not see even a single sound that so dominates the mind of a woman as the sound of a man.
an1.7:1.2: “The word ‘man,’ bhikkhus, can obsess the mind of a woman.
an1.8:1.1: “Bhikkhus, I do not see even one perfume that dominates the mind of a woman so entirely as does the perfume of a man.
an1.8:1.2: “The scent of a man, bhikkhus, can overpower the mind of a woman and remain there.
an1.9:1.1: “Bhikkhus, I do not see even one kind of sensual pleasure that so captivates the mind of a woman as does the sensual pleasure of a man.
an1.9:1.2: “The male sex-faculty, bhikkhus, dominates the mind of a woman,
an1.10:1.1: “Bhikkhus, I do not see even one kind of tangible object that, when touched, obsesses the minds of women as much as the tangible object of a man.
an1.10:1.2: “The touch of a man, bhikkhus, can occupy the mind of a woman.
an1.10:1.4: The aggregate of form and so on is the first.
